root_cause: The existing personal LinkedIn semantic gate blocked many business signals but still retained a single-use business exception and did not require an explicit machine-verifiable personal-life-only policy flag across contract, generation and pre-publish runtime.
prevention: Personal LinkedIn is exclusively personal life; business exceptions are forbidden.
Require explicit personal-life-only policy verification before authorization.
Inspect final text semantically for business, consultant, corporate and forced-business-moral signals.
Constrain the generator prompt and final-copy validator to the same personal-life-only fingerprint.
Keep business topics on the company page and keep personal/company learning models separate.
production_readback: Pending protected merge, Supabase function deployment/readback and exact-main terminal closure.
